prod.title: KhataKithab v0.5.5 - Budgets & Goals Unlocked, Global Period Filters & Financial Integrity
prod.summary: Major release unlocking Category Budgets and Savings Goals for all production users, persistent multi-device period selection, real-time savings rate analysis, centralized duplicate transaction detection, and comprehensive financial bounds validation.
highlights: 🎯 Production Unlock: Category Budgets & Savings Goals fully available on desktop & mobile
📅 Global Period Selector: Persistent date range filtering across devices (All time, 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y)
📊 Dynamic Savings Rate: Real-time calculation with authentic historical trend indicators
🛡️ Financial Integrity Engine: Centralized duplicate detection, safe money math, and bounds validation
✨ Animated Dialog Modals: Replaced browser popups with accessible ConfirmDialog flows

features.title: Category Budgets System
features.description: Monthly category spending caps with dynamic debit transaction aggregation, interactive SVG Budget Health Ring, real-time warning indicators, and animated adjustment modals.

features.title: Financial Savings Goals
features.description: Target milestone tracking, color-coded goal cards, due dates, notes, and an instant Add Funds deposit modal with live total previews.

features.title: Global Date Range Filter
features.description: Seamless global period selection persisted via server /api/preferences and Firestore sync across all user sessions and devices without layout flash.

features.title: Dynamic Savings Rate Summary Card
features.description: Real-time calculation strip using ((Income - Spending) / Income) * 100 with division protection and authentic month-over-month trend indicators.

features.title: Centralized Duplicate Detection
features.description: SHA-256 transaction fingerprinting preventing accidental duplicate manual and automated entries within 24 hours.

features.title: Money-Safe Math & Bounds Validation
features.description: Centralized sanitization protecting against NaN, Infinity, negative zero, and unrealistic amounts (> ₹10 Crores) with instant inline error warnings.

fixes: Replaced all raw browser confirm/alert popups with animated ConfirmDialog modals
Eliminated synthetic trend arrows to ensure all comparisons reflect authentic saved history
Protected reducing balance EMI formulas against singular zero-interest divisions
Added live input validation feedback and submit protection against unrealistic amounts
